title: AI code review GitHub Action
tagline: A reusable GitHub Action that reviews every pull request with Claude and posts one review with inline comments and one-click fixes.
problem: Review bots that comment on unchanged lines, repeat themselves on every push, or hide what they cost get switched off within a week.
built: An Action that parses the unified diff itself so it can only comment on changed lines, measures every request with the token-counting endpoint, shares a cached system prompt across batches, validates each finding against the added lines, and posts one review with inline comments, suggestion blocks, a severity table, a verdict and the estimated cost. Findings already on the pull request are never posted twice.
highlights: Structured output with a zod schema: findings, summary, verdict and estimated cost
Severity table, suggestion blocks, optional failing check via fail_on
71 unit tests, 13 eval cases, mock provider for CI without a key
testing: 71 unit tests and 13 eval cases run without a key through a mock provider, and the repository reviews its own pull requests with the Action.
